newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Polnobanka SKK 1.5bln bond issue on Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Polnobanka SKK 1.5bln bond issue on Nov 27.

text.p: Polnobanka a.s., Slovakia's fourth largest commercial bank, will issue a tranche of four-year bonds totalling up to 1.5 billion crowns on November 27, the bank said in a published statement on Wednesday.
The publicly traded bonds which will have a nominal value of 10,000 crowns, will carry a fixed annual coupon of 12 percent, the statement added.
Funds from the issue will be used for "extending of the commercial framework of the bank", the statement said.
No further details were disclosed. Bank officials were not immediately available for comment.

Polnobanka's main shareholders are Slovenska Poistovna, the country's largest insurer (31.9 percent), the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (20 percent), and the Slovak Agriculture Ministry (8.6 percent).
About 20 percent of Polnobanka shares are held by other small shareholders.
Two north Italian regional investment groups, Unicredito S.p.A. and Finest S.p.A., hold 2.6 and 2.8 percent stakes respectively in Polnobanka.
Earlier this year the two Italian partners asked the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) to approve an increase of their holdings in Polnobanka up to a total 15 percent.
In June, Polnobanka shareholders also approved a 600 million crown increase in its basic capital to 1.85 billion through a share issue with pre-purchase rights.
